items.source: Returns the raw, unqualified reference, i.e. the field reference without a $ prefix.
items.translation: 返回原始的非限定引用，即不带$前缀的字段引用。

items.source: Returns the reference value for the given field reference.

items.source:
Returns the reference value for the given field reference. Will return 1 for a synthetic, unaliased field or the
raw rendering of the reference otherwise.
items.translation: 返回给定字段引用的引用值。对于合成且未别名的字段，将返回 1；否则，返回该引用的原始渲染形式。
